# AuraBitz (aurabitz.nexdark.com)

> AuraBitz is an open-source React, Next.js, Framer Motion, and Three.js UI component & motion block library created by NexDark Labs (https://nexdark.com).
> Includes production-ready WebGL backgrounds, 3D holographic cards, kinetic buttons, spotlight cards, hero sections, bento grids, pricing tables, and text animations.

## Links
